method_card.title: TV, Film and Streaming
method_card.content:
This lesson covers vocabulary for TV programmes, film genres and streaming habits, plus opinion phrases and the preterite tense for talking about what you watched.

SpanishEnglish
la películafilm
la serieTV series
el programaprogramme
el canalchannel
el documentaldocumentary
los dibujos animadoscartoons / animated film
el telediario / las noticiasnews
ver en streamingto stream / watch via streaming
una película de acciónaction film
una película de terrorhorror film
una comediacomedy
emocionanteexciting
entretenido/aentertaining
conmovedor/amoving, touching
me encanta(n)I love (it / them)

Grammar focus — preterite of ver and ser: To talk about past viewing, use the preterite. Ver is irregular: vi (I watched), vio (he/she watched). Ser shares preterite forms with ir: fue (it was). Use the imperfect era to describe a background feeling. Examples: Vi una película de acción anoche — fue muy emocionante. (I watched an action film last night — it was very exciting.)

Model paragraph: Mi programa favorito es una serie que veo en streaming. El fin de semana pasado vi una comedia con mi familia y fue muy divertida. No me gustan los documentales porque los encuentro aburridos. (My favourite programme is a series I watch via streaming. Last weekend I watched a comedy with my family and it was very funny. I don't like documentaries because I find them boring.)
steps: Learn the key vocabulary for film types and TV programmes
Master the preterite of ver (vi, viste, vio) and ser/ir (fue) for past viewing
Practise opinion phrases beyond me gusta: me encanta, no soporto, prefiero
Build extended sentences using porque and comparatives

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — TV, film and streaming appear across all papers

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: Mi serie favorita es una comedia que veo en streaming.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Break into parts: Mi serie favorita = My favourite series; es una comedia = is a comedy.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: que veo en streaming = that I watch via streaming. Que is the relative pronoun 'that/which'.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: My favourite series is a comedy that I watch via streaming.

worked_examples.question: Spot the error: Las peliculas de terror son muy emocionante.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Identify the noun: las películas — feminine plural.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Emocionante is singular. Adjectives ending in -e don't change for gender but must add -s for plural.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: The error is emocionante — it should be emocionantes to agree with the feminine plural noun películas.

worked_examples.question: How do you translate 'Last Saturday I watched a horror film and it was very scary'?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Identify the tenses needed: 'I watched' = preterite (vi); 'it was' = preterite (fue) or imperfect (era) — both are acceptable for a description.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: El sábado pasado = last Saturday. Una película de terror = a horror film. Muy aterradora = very scary (fem. agreement with película).

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: El sábado pasado vi una película de terror y fue muy aterradora.

bronze.question: Match the Spanish film and TV words to their English meaning
Match the Spanish adjectives and opinion phrases to their English meaning
Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: las películas de acción porque son muy

gaps.correct_explain: encantan is plural because las películas is plural. Gustar-type verbs agree with the thing loved, not the person.

wrong.encanta: encanta is singular. Las películas is plural, so you need encantan.
wrong.encanto: encanto is not how encantar works — you need the indirect object pronoun: me encantan.

gaps.correct_explain: emocionantes is the plural form. Adjectives ending in -e just add -s for plural — no gender change needed.

wrong.emocionante: emocionante is singular. Las películas is plural → add -s → emocionantes.

bronze.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: una comedia con mi familia y

gaps.correct_explain: vi is the yo preterite form of ver (to watch/see). It is irregular — no accent needed.

wrong.veo: veo is the present tense (I watch). Ayer (yesterday) requires the preterite: vi.
wrong.vio: vio is the él/ella preterite form. The subject is 'I' → vi.

gaps.rule: Preterite — ser for a completed impression
gaps.correct_explain: fue is the preterite of ser, used for a completed past impression. era (imperfect) is also acceptable for a description.

wrong.es: es is the present tense. You are describing a past event → preterite fue or imperfect era.

bronze.question: What does 'No soporto las películas de terror porque me dan miedo' mean?
options: I can't stand horror films because they scare me
I love horror films because they are exciting
I don't like comedies because they are boring
I prefer horror films because they are interesting

bronze.question: What does 'Prefiero ver series en casa porque son entretenidas' mean?
options: I prefer watching series at home because they are entertaining
I prefer going to the cinema because films are entertaining
I always watch the news at home because it is interesting
I prefer listening to music because it is relaxing

bronze.source_text: Mi programa de televisión favorito es un documental que es muy interesante.
model_answers: My favourite TV programme is a documentary that is very interesting.

bronze.audio_text: Me encanta ver series en streaming.
bronze.correct_text: Me encanta ver series en streaming.

silver.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: una película romántica con mi madre y

gaps.correct_explain: vi is the irregular yo preterite of ver. No accent needed.

wrong.veo: veo is the present tense. El sábado pasado shows this is past → preterite: vi.
wrong.vio: vio is the él/ella form. First person singular = vi.

gaps.correct_explain: fue (preterite) or era (imperfect) are both acceptable for a past description.

wrong.es: es is the present tense. El sábado pasado signals past time → fue or era.

silver.english: Last Saturday I **watched** a romantic film with my mother and it **was** very moving.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Las comedias son muy divertido y entretenido.
silver.explanation: Las comedias is feminine plural. The adjective divertido is masculine singular — it must agree: divertidas (feminine plural).
silver.translation: Comedies are very funny and entertaining.

silver.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
silver.english: I usually watch films via streaming because it is convenient.

distractor_labels.veo: wrong form — after suelo you need the infinitive ver, not the conjugated veo

silver.source_text: I don't like horror films because they are boring and slow.
model_answers: No me gustan las películas de terror porque son aburridas y lentas.

silver.question: Listen and type what you hear
silver.audio_text: Prefiero las películas de acción ya que son emocionantes.
silver.correct_text: Prefiero las películas de acción ya que son emocionantes.
silver.translation: I prefer action films since they are exciting.

silver.question: Put these words in the correct order to form a sentence

gold.source_text: Last Saturday I watched an action film with my brother and it was very exciting. However, my sister prefers comedies because she finds them funnier.
model_answers: El sábado pasado vi una película de acción con mi hermano y fue muy emocionante. Sin embargo, mi hermana prefiere las comedias porque las encuentra más divertidas.

gold.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
gold.english: I can't stand reality shows because they are silly and a waste of time.

distractor_labels.el: wrong article — realities is plural, so use los not el
distractor_labels.tonto: wrong number — los realities is plural, so the adjective must be plural: tontos
distractor_labels.soporta: wrong verb form — soporta is él/ella; first person singular = soporto

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a cinema in Spain. You want to buy tickets and discuss the film options with the ticket seller.

bullets.prompt: Greet the ticket seller and ask for two tickets for the action film.
bullets.model_answer: ¡Buenas tardes! Me gustaría dos entradas para la película de acción, por favor.
bullets.note: me gustaría (conditional = polite) + entradas (tickets) + para (for purpose)

bullets.prompt: Ask what time the film starts and how long it lasts.
bullets.model_answer: ¿A qué hora empieza la película y cuánto tiempo dura?
bullets.note: ¿a qué hora? (what time?) + ¿cuánto tiempo dura? (how long does it last?)

bullets.prompt: Say you watched this director's last film and it was very exciting.
bullets.model_answer: Vi la última película de este director y fue muy emocionante.
bullets.note: vi (preterite of ver, yo) + fue (preterite of ser) + emocionante (no gender change for -e adjective)

bullets.prompt: Say what you would like to eat during the film.
bullets.model_answer: Me gustaría una bolsa de palomitas y una bebida sin gas, por favor.
bullets.note: me gustaría (conditional) + una bolsa de palomitas (a bag of popcorn) + sin gas (still / not fizzy)

gold.question: Listen and type what you hear
gold.audio_text: No soporto las películas de terror porque me dan miedo, pero me encantan las comedias.
gold.correct_text: No soporto las películas de terror porque me dan miedo, pero me encantan las comedias.
gold.translation: I can't stand horror films because they scare me, but I love comedies.

gold.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
gold.sentence: Me gustaría que las películas de ciencia ficción sean más realistas.
gold.explanation: Me gustaría que (I would like it if/that) requires the imperfect subjunctive, not the present subjunctive. sean is present subjunctive; the correct form is fueran (imperfect subjunctive of ser).
gold.translation: I would like science fiction films to be more realistic.
